rulingsApplied.R-01: cut.length in declared metres (and the candidate in cm / cm2) at 0.35 m per model unit
rulingsApplied.R-03: every value from W-04's 20 medium plan seeds; the 2026-09-25 captures only as the fixture check
rulingsApplied.R-09: template roads by draw order and width class (the tool's docstring); the pooled, ring, plain and per-template sets are the target values, the five face classes descriptive, a class with < 10 bounded bent cuts a known-defects entry
rulingsApplied.R-14: plan section 7b faces[] with referenceBuild on every face (N-02), hood ids from W-11b's file
rulingsApplied.R-15: cut.length = the fillet-free course between the snapped ends, 5 m bins to 400 m plus overflow, spreadKS.p90 per template subset
rulingsApplied.R-47 (a): measured values; each block carries its sample

cutSets.bounded: cuts whose parent face is rebuilt (bounded; the faces the candidate carries)
cutSets.allCuts: every non-template street (open parents included): the face-free measures

definitions.cut.sigma: f = the drawn start e0 snapped to the crossed centreline as a fraction of the parent's E1 OBB major axis (the outer cycle on a holed parent); N(0.5, sigma) + eps U(0, 1) by maximum likelihood on bentcut_anchor's grids; not fitted below 10 cuts. rebuiltParents = every bounded cut; simpleParents = the simple-parent set section 13.5's 0.066 / 0.098 were measured on
definitions.cut.cornerMid: |t - 0.5| <= 0.10 with t = |e0 Pv| / (|e0 Pv| + |Pv eN|) on bounded cuts with a three-point course
definitions.cut.arrival85: junction ends arriving at >= 85 degrees to the crossed road (bentcut_geometry)
definitions.cut.fillet: one-bend cuts whose bend is a multi-vertex arc
definitions.cut.length: the fillet-free course length between the snapped ends, declared metres; bounded cuts
definitions.quantiles: type 7 (V12 section 3.5.1); estimators minmax at 2-9 seeds, type7 at >= 10 (W-15 re-forms them)
definitions.spreadKS: V12 section 3.5.3: p90 of the seed-pair KS distances; binned on the 5 m edges (primary) and raw ECDF

candidate.frame: the registered road frame of adapters/ng.py --plan (W-11b): cm = road-canvas px / ctmScale x 35, rounded half to even, consecutive repeats dropped; rings closed (first vertex repeated); outer rings positive shoelace area, holes negative (the hoods' orientation)
candidate.ringCm: E1: the parent face as drawn (fillet arcs as chords; a junction node whose two boundary edges lie on one road dropped), outer cycle; holesCm its inner cycles
candidate.blockAreasCm2: the bounded leaf faces inside the face (every block its cuts created), integer cm2 by cumulative rounding along the union's final order, sorted ascending; their sum is the face's exact area within 1 cm2
candidate.cuts: the face's own cut first, then every cut inside it in drawing (creation) order
candidate.cornerT: t in thousandths for a one-bend cut, -1 otherwise
candidate.arrivalCdeg: the smaller of the cut's two junction-end arrival angles, centidegrees
candidate.fillet: 1 when the one bend is drawn as an arc
candidate.excluded: a rebuilt parent whose ring is not simple at integer cm (the slit a band's first cut leaves) is kept research-side only; its cuts are in its parent annulus's record

checks.check: the fixture run still prints 11 / 11 (the 2026-09-25 numbers as the generalised rule's red test: the rule's template sets equal W-10's TEMPLATE_W sets on every fixture map; no edge collapsed)
cut.length's bins are the registry's (metrics.m-1.json: 5 m edges 0-400 m, no underflow, overflow)

absFloor.basis: default: lengths 2 % of the reference median

checks.check: built blocks (W-11b's rule: >= 1 footprint area centroid) re-derived on the faces equal E11 section 10's per-seed counts on every map
template roads by draw order and width class (R-09): street 1 and square 3 roads on every map, area and ring none; no other street at the template width; the script's template set equals the rule's

the face graph equals W-11b's adapter on every map (faces, open faces, blocks), after the duplicate-edge collapse; the registered frame: every ring vertex on a MeasureInput way, bounded face areas = its blocks
each parent's area equals its leaves' sum on every map (holes subtracted; 1e-6 relative and 1 cm2 declared)
header: schema, referenceBuild at the top, metricsVersion, scaleDeclared, outlineKind; no other key
hoods: W-11b's 20 records unchanged and its section 7b checks re-run (integer cm, closed simple rings, C2, referenceBuild on each)
checks.detail: 20 hoods: integer ids 0..19, integer cm, closed simple rings, cm area = hull area within 0.1 %, C2 patterns, referenceBuild on each

checks.check: faces: integer ids 0..n-1; the section 7b fields exactly; referenceBuild on every face (N-02); hood and template consistent; class flags 0/1; every coordinate an integer; rings closed and simple, outer positive and holes negative, holes inside; every ring vertex inside its hood outline (2 cm slack); block areas positive integers; cut records exact with values in range (cornerT -1 whenever bends != 1; fillet only on one-bend cuts)
every number an integer (the header's declared 0.35 m per model unit apart); no boolean

every string matches V12 section 3.3 C2's pattern for its field (seedLabel, capture, referenceBuild) or the schema's enumeration / constant (template, schema, metricsVersion); no hex-delimited six-digit run in any string (N-03's reading; the literal "anywhere" reading is reported beside it)

every face's area equals its leaves' sum within one cm2: the exact face area against the exact leaves (every rebuilt parent), and the file's integer block areas (cumulative rounding along the union order) against the exact face area, with each face's leaf count; the integer rings' own area within their coordinate-rounding bound of the file's sum
the formula sigma against section 13.5's 0.066 / 0.098 compared (and the other recorded numbers); every departure beyond the floor listed for DC-26's successor
